pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro mahāmatto pavāsaṃ gacchanto bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.7: atha kho so mahāmatto ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhadantā mayā dūte pahite nāgacchissanti”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.11: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa mahāmattassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.12: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.1.13: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.5: addasa kho āyasmā ānando senāsanacārikaṃ āhiṇḍanto tāni cīvarāni cīvaravaṃse bhaṇḍikābaddhāni. tiṭṭhante, disvā bhikkhū etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.9: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa yathānikkhittaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.11: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū accekacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.12: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.13: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū accekacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmentī”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.16: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā accekacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetvā cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmessanti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.18: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.19.1: “dasāhānāgataṃ kattikatemāsikapuṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno paneva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:1.2.20: tato ce uttari nikkhipeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.6: senāya vā gantukāmo hoti, pavāsaṃ vā gantukāmo hoti, gilāno vā hoti, gabbhinī vā hoti, assaddhassa vā saddhā uppannā hoti, appasannassa vā pasādo uppanno hoti, so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya: “āgacchantu bhadantā, vassāvāsikaṃ dassāmīti” etaṃ accekacīvaraṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.7: accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ paṭiggahetvā yāva cīvarakālasamayaṃ nikkhipitabbanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.13: anatthate kathine vassānassa pacchimaṃ divasaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.14: atthate kaṭhine kaṭhinuddhāradivasaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.15: nissajitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.23.1: accekacīvare accekacīvarasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.24: accekacīvare vematiko cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.25: accekacīvare anaccekacīvarasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.32: avilutte viluttasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.33: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np28:2.38: antosamayaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti, vissajjeti nassati vinassati ḍayhati, acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
